scenes.name: bank-along-the-road
scenes.prompt: We sweep left and bank above a broad golden ribbon road suspended among enormous black basalt towers. The nearest black and gilded column slips past the right edge, revealing luminous open cloud space beyond. The graceful curved road continues through the middle toward one distant slender black spire, while finely engraved bridges slide diagonally past us. An impossible ancient city with intricate microscopic gold filigree, tiny carved balconies, lacework buttresses and rich sculpted dimensional relief. The viewpoint follows the road through a wide sweeping bend. Black lacquer, radiant metallic gold, bone-white clouds and luminous atmospheric depth. Finely detailed visionary architectural painting, no people, no letters, no picture frame.

scenes.name: find-the-circular-courtyard
scenes.prompt: The golden ribbon road sweeps around a vast suspended circular courtyard emerging from pearl clouds. The nearest black towers slide out at the edges to reveal the circular courtyard ahead: concentric engraved golden terraces around a deep dark central opening, like an immense ancient mechanical iris. Fine curved ribs connect the tiers. Extraordinary ancient lost city of black lacquer stone and exquisitely engraved brass, thousands of tiny galleries and curved bridges. Spacious clear view toward the round courtyard, intricate visionary architectural painting, radiant gold and bone-white mist, no people, no text, no flat graphic diagram.

motion_note.intent: Carry forward momentum into a broad leftward bank; let the near right column pass aside while the distant spire anchors the route. Reveal a circular courtyard rather than another centered push.
